positions.title: Presenter
positions.description: Your site shouldn't be just a refrigerator door showcasing your accomplishments and photos. Often, web development requests and discussions tend to focus on how a site looks or what a site should include. This can often negate what the site should accomplish. Sites also tend to speak about the institution and its accomplishments, and may neglect to effectively engage their audience. During this webcast, you’ll learn how you can start changing how you create and request site content by combining behavior data and storytelling structure.

positions.title: Database Administrator/Microcomputer & Network Support Technician
positions.description:
Provide technical assistance for 100+ employees, partners, and affiliates and their computers.
Maintain the agency’s state-regulated database including the server that allowed connectivity to the database.
Instruct employees, partners, and clients on basic computer use.
Create and update the agency website and online employment application.
Compile, design, and publish the monthly newsletter, annual booklet, and other print media as needed.

positions.title: Sales Consultant
positions.description:
Maintained knowledge in current technology to assist customers with products to meet their mobile and financial
needs.
Assisted customers and employees in troubleshooting minor computer and electronic device errors.
Addressed customer concerns to ensure they were receiving the best-possible experience.

positions.title: Head Server
positions.description:
Maintained communication between kitchen, service-staff, and guests.
Educated and trained new service-staff.
Answered any guest questions, catered to guests’ needs, and ensured overall guest satisfaction.
